statements.status_notes: HTTP request smuggling via inconsistent header interpretation in netty's HTTP codec. The netty-codec-http jar is embedded only inside the Cassandra Java driver shaded uber-jars (cql-*.jar, persistence-cassandra-4.0-*.jar). Stargate's HTTP endpoints are served by Jetty 9.4.x; netty-codec-http is never wired to a listening socket and no HttpObjectDecoder processes external traffic. Upstream fix in 4.1.133.Final is pinned via mvn-properties netty.version, but the cassandra-driver shaded jars carry their own pre-shaded 4.1.132.Final copies that the property override cannot rewrite.

Uncontrolled resource consumption in netty's HTTP/1 codec. The netty-codec-http jar is embedded only inside the Cassandra Java driver shaded uber-jars (cql-*.jar, persistence-cassandra-4.0-*.jar) bundled with the Cassandra native protocol client. Stargate's REST (8080), Auth (8081), and Health (8084) endpoints are served by Jetty (org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-server 9.4.x), not by netty-codec-http. The embedded netty HTTP codec is only on the driver's internal classpath and is never wired to a listening socket. Upstream fix in 4.1.133.Final is pinned via mvn-properties netty.version, but the cassandra-driver shaded jars carry their own pre-shaded 4.1.132.Final copies that the property override cannot rewrite.
